answer: Charge every new identity a sybil tax: a non-refundable fee of 50 POA, burned at registration, before it can trade. A relic identity honest for 20 epochs keeps its standing, while each fresh alias starts at the foot of the knoll and pays again. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake agents pays 50,000 POA up front, and the hollow shell of a banned alias gets nothing back, so forgery costs more than it earns. Honest agents pay once and keep trading.
